images.title: Noticing and asking why
images.purpose: Show that a list of mornings only records what happened, while a rule explains it and can be used elsewhere.
images.composition: Two shapes side by side with a wide gap and one arrow between them, centred.
images.exact_structure: Left: a plain notebook page (rounded rectangle) holding exactly 3 short lines of equal length, each starting with a amber #E69F00 Sun circle. Right: a teal #0072B2 rule card (rounded rectangle, same size) holding one amber #E69F00 Sun circle on a curved arc. One grey #6B7280 arrow points from the page to the card. Exactly 2 rectangles, 1 arrow, 2 labels.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any question mark, bubble or person
images.takeaway: Noticing gives a list; asking why gives a rule we can use elsewhere.
images.description: A notebook page of Sun marks turning into a rule card by an arrow.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to say what the card tells us that the page does not.

image_decisions.why: One list becoming one rule card is the whole idea; no scene is needed.
